description: Phase 2C for RSI_1h_edge_discovery: compare base ATR-normalized anchor-stack width against 1h ATR-normalized anchor-stack width, before adding active RSI 1h filters.
notes: Phase 2B confirmed the base ATR width core around w11/r12 with lb20 as stability baseline and lb10 as sharp peak.
Phase 2C does not add RSI as a blocker. It tests whether the width measurement itself should use 1h ATR normalization.
Base controls preserve selected Phase 2B candidates.
Do not compare numeric width thresholds directly between base ATR and 1h ATR. This phase discovers the 1h ATR width scale.
Still no ADX runner, runtime exits, BE, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, or asymmetric rails.

metadata.role: Final Phase 2B upper semantic balanced comparator
Final Phase 2B upper semantic PnL comparator
Final Phase 2B short-heavy profit lane; comparator only
